name: Albuquerque
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Albuquerque for 2026, and here is what he found: 38 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Winter Wonderland NM at EXPO New Mexico) through January 4 (Pueblo Gingerbread Contest), with the Civic Plaza Holiday Tree Lighting (December 1), the Twinkle Light Parade (December 5) and the Trolley of Lights tours (December 15 to 28) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Albuquerque

  • 38 Christmas events for kids in Albuquerque
  • 8 free events, including Winrock Wonderland, the Civic Plaza Holiday Tree Lighting and the Children's Messiah
  • Meet Santa: free photos at Winrock Wonderland (November 27), Santa at Winter Wonderland NM, and Breakfast with Santa at the Cathedral of St. John (December 12)
  • Parades, tree lightings and lights: Old Town Plaza Tree Lighting, Twinkle Light Parade, River of Lights and the Trolley of Lights
  • Nutcrackers: New Mexico Ballet Company at Popejoy Hall and Festival Ballet Albuquerque at the National Hispanic Cultural Center
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to January 4, 2027
